title: Change the details on an Owner-Builder Permit
summary: Find out how to apply for a new Owner-Builder Permit or amend an existing one if your details have changed.
intro:
If you have an Owner-Builder Permit to supervise building on your own private residential site and details have changed since your permit was issued (except for a change of name) you need to visit a service centre and apply for a new permit.

If details such as your name or address have been incorrectly recorded visit a service centre and have your permit amended.
what_you_need: supporting document as evidence of the change (such as a rates notice or a letter from your local authority)

more_info.text: To find your permit number and details, visit Verify NSW.

external_links.text: Becoming an owner-builder – Building Commission NSW

faqs.q: What should I do if my details have changed for my Owner-Builder Permit?
faqs.a: If details such as your name or address have been incorrectly recorded, you need to visit a service centre to have your permit amended.

faqs.q: Do I need to apply for a new permit if my details have changed?
faqs.a: If you have an Owner-Builder Permit and details have changed (except for a change of name), you must visit a service centre and apply for a new permit.
